title: Severance Pay Calculation Under Labor Proclamation 1156/2019
description: I have worked at a private manufacturing firm in Addis Ababa for 4 years and was recently terminated without prior written notice. How should my severance pay and compensation for lack of notice be computed?

answers.content: Under Ethiopian Labor Proclamation No. 1156/2019 Article 39 and 40, an employee terminated unlawfully is entitled to severance pay equal to 30 times the average daily wage for the first year of service, plus one-third for each subsequent year, in addition to compensation under Article 43.
